mapper.sql: SELECT env_data.ed_id, env_data.dev_id, env_data.dev_name, env_data.dev_posi, env_data.dev_val, env_data.val_type, env_data.collect_time, env_data.th_flag FROM env_data WHERE 1 = 1
mapper.insert: insert into env_data(dev_id, dev_name, dev_posi, dev_val, val_type, collect_time, th_flag) values(#{devId}, #{devName}, #{devPosi}, #{devVal}, #{valType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, (select ifnull( (select 0 from data_threshold t where t.th_type = #{valType} and #{devVal} between t.th_min and t.th_max), 1)))
mapper.update:
update env_data
dev_id = #{devId},
dev_name = #{devName},
dev_posi = #{devPosi},
dev_val = #{devVal},
val_type = #{valType},
collect_time = #{collectTime},
th_flag = #{thFlag},
WHERE ed_id = #{edId}
mapper.select: SELECT e.dev_id devId, e.dev_name devName, e.dev_posi devPosi, e.collect_time collectTime, SUM(CASE WHEN e.val_type = 1 THEN e.dev_val ELSE 0 END) temp, SUM(CASE WHEN e.val_type = 2 THEN e.dev_val ELSE 0 END) humi, SUM(CASE WHEN e.val_type = 3 THEN e.dev_val ELSE 0 END) light FROM env_data e WHERE (e.dev_id, e.dev_name, e.dev_posi, e.collect_time) IN ( SELECT e.dev_id, e.dev_name, e.dev_posi, MAX(e.collect_time) FROM env_data e GROUP BY e.dev_id, e.dev_name, e.dev_posi -- 分组取每个设备最新时间 ) GROUP BY e.dev_id, e.dev_name, e.dev_posi, e.collect_time;
select e.dev_val from env_data e where e.val_type = #{type} -- 所有的指定类型数据 order by collect_time DESC -- 按最新时间排序 limit 0, 1
select count(1) from env_data e where e.th_flag = 1 -- 异常数据

select k.time, k.temp, k.humi, k.light from( select t.time, round(sum(case when t.val_type=1 then t.val else 0 end),2) temp, round(sum(case when t.val_type=2 then t.val else 0 end),2) humi, round(sum(case when t.val_type=3 then t.val else 0 end),2) light from ( select avg(e.dev_val) val, e.val_type, concat(DATE_FORMAT(e.collect_time, '%m-%d %H'),':00') time from env_data e group by e.val_type, concat(DATE_FORMAT(e.collect_time, '%m-%d %H'),':00'), e.val_type) t group by t.time order by t.time desc LIMIT 24) k order by k.time asc
select count(1) value, case e.th_flag when 0 THEN '正常' ELSE '异常' end name from env_data e group by e.th_flag;
SELECT round(AVG(e.dev_val),2) avg_temp, e.dev_name from env_data e where e.val_type = 1 and e.collect_time between DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 72 HOUR) and NOW() group by e.dev_name
